subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What different themes do students raise in these open responses?

judge.implied_focus: Thematic content of student open responses -- the set of distinct themes (engagement, technical issues, social interaction, hands-on learning, teacher effectiveness, asynchronous benefits, equity, attention) students raise about their learning experience

per_column.name: theme_engagement
per_column.rationale: Binary flag for a specific substantive theme; a coherent facet of response content.

per_column.name: theme_technical_issues
per_column.rationale: Distinct theme flag, non-overlapping content facet.

per_column.name: theme_social_interaction
per_column.rationale: Distinct theme flag centred on response content.

per_column.name: theme_teacher_effectiveness
per_column.rationale: Distinct theme flag; most prevalent, a meaningful facet.

per_column.name: theme_asynchronous_benefits
per_column.rationale: Distinct theme flag capturing a specific content dimension.

per_column.name: theme_equity_concerns
per_column.rationale: Distinct theme flag, substantive and actionable.

per_column.name: theme_attention_focus
per_column.rationale: Distinct theme flag, though rare in the data.

per_column.name: detected_themes
per_column.rationale: Aggregated co-occurring theme set; usefully summarises multi-theme responses and confirms the decomposition.

judge.rationale: All added columns centre tightly on ONE coherent, data-inferable focus: the thematic content of student open responses. The system proposed a set of eight distinct, mutually differentiated substantive themes (not bare sentiment or token counts) plus an aggregate multi-label summary, forming a sound multi-facet decomposition at a useful granularity. This directly and non-trivially serves the query 'what different themes do students raise', giving analysts actionable, investigable dimensions (e.g., teacher effectiveness dominates; equity and attention are rare). The only minor deductions are that the themes are individual binary facets whose collective coverage is asserted rather than shown, and the redundant detected_themes column overlaps the flags; neither undermines the focus. Strong pass on all three criteria.
